content: Simulated baseline id 1 (reward -0.6243) and id 2 (reward -0.8341). Id 1 is the best reference: gain 599.7, SR 34.11, noise 0.020, but UGBW=41.3MHz and PM=37.2 deg. Reducing ln1 in id 2 collapsed gain (91.8), so keep ln1>=90nm. Intent: keep balance condition S_mp3/S_mp1 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4; raise gm6 (mp3, mn5) to push 2nd pole gm6/CL higher for PM, and adjust Cc/Rc to reach UGBW>=100MHz and PM>=60.

Best id 1 (reward -0.6243). Violated: ugbw (-0.416, 41.3MHz) and phm (-0.234, 37.2 deg). Chosen lever: boost stage-1 gm1 by increasing mn1 (8 -> 16) and reduce Cc (1.0pF -> 0.7pF) to increase UGBW towards target 100MHz while observing PM.

Tested id 3 (from 1 with mn1=16, cap=0.7pF): UGBW increased from 41.3MHz to 50.95MHz, but PM dropped from 37.2 to 30.4 deg. Lesson: lower Cc and higher gm1 move UGBW closer to p2, degrading PM without zero optimization.

Swept res on id 1: res=3000 ohm (id 8) achieved PM=61.61 deg (feasible on PM!), raising reward to -0.3536. Only ugbw remains violated (45.49MHz vs 100MHz). Rc > 1/gm6 pushed zero to LHP, dramatically enhancing PM.

Best id 8 (reward -0.3536). Only violated spec is ugbw (-0.375, 45.5MHz vs 100MHz). Chosen lever: reduce Cc (1.0pF -> 0.5pF) and increase mn1 (8 -> 14) to double UGBW, while setting res to 4500 ohm to preserve the LHP zero and PM >= 60 deg.
Simulated id 9 (from 8 with mn1=14, cap=0.5pF, res=4500): reward improved to -0.2120. UGBW reached 68.25MHz (from 45.5MHz) and PM reached 54.75 deg. Both are within striking distance of feasibility.

Candidate 11 raised gm6 with mp3,mn5=16x1.5u: UGBW surged to 127.8MHz (feasible!), SR 59.1V/us, Gain 607.9, noise 0.0175. PM reached 59.11 deg (0.89 deg below 60 deg target). Reward 0.00127. Close to feasible.

Best id 11 (reward 0.00127). Only spec violated is phm (59.11 vs 60.0 deg). Chosen lever: sweep res around 5.5k-7.5k on id 11 to extract the final ~1 deg of phase margin from the LHP zero and achieve feasibility (FoM > 0.3).
Candidate 16 is FEASIBLE! Reward = 0.4977. Specs: gain=607.9, UGBW=110.5MHz, PM=63.61 deg, SR=53.4V/us, noise=0.0172V. Area=5.42e-10, current=440.8uA. Feasibility phase 1 complete in 16 simulations.

Best feasible id 16 (reward 0.4977). Current is the dominating cost (z_current=+0.376). Chosen lever: increase mn3 from 2 to 3 to lower all mirrored currents proportionally (Itail 60->40uA, I2 360->240uA), preserving balance and significantly reducing current while keeping specs within margins.

Candidate 17 (mn3 2->3): current dropped to 308uA as expected, but UGBW dropped to 72MHz due to lower gm1. Lesson: keep Itail~60uA (mn3=2, mn4=4) for UGBW, and reduce I2 via mn5/mp3 instead while keeping balance S_mp3=S_mn5.

Candidate 18 (mp3,mn5 16->14) is FEASIBLE with FoM = 0.5456 (up from 0.4977). Current trimmed to 396.5uA. UGBW=100.4MHz, PM=62.44 deg, Gain=607.9, SR=52.5V/us. Balance condition S_mp3=S_mn5 perfectly verified.
Candidate 19 (mn1=22): noise improved to 0.01658 and UGBW stayed 100.6MHz, but area penalty dropped FoM from 0.5456 to 0.5407. Candidate 18 remains best design.

Best design is id 18 (feasible, FoM 0.5456). Binding specs are UGBW (100.4MHz vs 100MHz target) and PM (62.44 vs 60 deg). All critical margins are tight and 1D hand sizing has plateaued. Decision: hand over to rl for multi-dimensional local refinement anchored on id 18.

Phase 3 RL refinement completed using 500 simulations (100 warmup, 400 train). Best feasible id before: 18 (FoM 0.5456); after: 18 (FoM 0.5456). Replay buffer now has 530 transitions, 9 feasible designs generated. Two consecutive batches showed no improvement over expert design 18. Stopping RL and handing over to polish.

Specs: current=307.2uA, gain=643.8, ugbw=101.1MHz, PM=71.03 deg, SR=48.22V/us, noise=0.0152V, area=6.78e-10. RL found balanced multi-device trade-off: mn3=3, mn4=5, mn5=15, mp1=3, mp3=15, cap=0.8pF, res=5000. 20 feasible designs in Pareto buffer.

Diagnoser: RL best design 873 has FoM=0.5822 with current=307.2uA, PM=71.03 deg (+11 deg margin), and UGBW=101.1MHz. Chosen polish lever: test slight reduction in Cc or res to trim area while holding UGBW >= 100MHz.
